_comment_toolToggles: Optional per-tool enable/disable. When 'enabledTools' is a non-empty array, ONLY those tools are exposed (allowlist). Otherwise, any tool listed in 'disabledTools' is hidden (denylist). enabledTools takes precedence. Env overrides: COLLIBRA_ENABLED_TOOLS / COLLIBRA_DISABLED_TOOLS (comma-separated).
_comment_secrets: Any value can be a secret reference instead of plaintext: ${env:NAME}, ${file:/run/secrets/name}, or ${keychain:target} (Windows Credential Manager generic credential, macOS Keychain service, Linux libsecret service).
_comment_instances: auth.type: 'basic' (default) or 'session' (REST session login with cookie + CSRF; auto re-login). OAuth is not used, so this works for FedRAMP and self-hosted (CPSH). tls.caFile trusts a custom/agency CA (preferred over 'insecure'); tls.clientCertFile + tls.clientKeyFile enable mutual TLS.
_comment_externalSources: Opt-in only. External sources call public internet APIs; leave disabled in FedRAMP / restricted-egress environments.
_comment_skillsDir: Optional: external skills directory merged over the embedded catalog. Layout: <dir>/<namespace>/<name>/SKILL.md. Env override: COLLIBRA_MCP_SKILLS_DIR.
_comment_http: Optional: serve MCP over streamable HTTP on localhost instead of stdio. Also enabled by --http[=port] or COLLIBRA_MCP_HTTP_PORT.
_comment_validateOutput: Optional: when true, tool outputs are checked against their outputSchema and mismatches are logged (warn-only).
_comment_audit: Optional tamper-evident audit trail (hash-chained JSONL) used by get_audit_log and undo_write. path defaults to <config dir>/logs/audit.jsonl. Forced on by complianceMode.
_comment_complianceMode: Optional: set to "fedramp" to enforce https + verified TLS, secret references (no plaintext passwords), no external sources, and mandatory audit at startup. requireFips makes a non-FIPS Node runtime a startup error.
